title: AgentContract
description: Parsed form of one pack agent (.claude/agents/<name>.md) as produced by .claude/runtime/build-pack-registry.mjs. The markdown file is the single source; this contract is what the registry builder and validate-pack-contracts.mjs verify against: identity and classification, the tool ceiling, the declared capabilities and skills, the write scope and the approval class, and that every mandatory section (identity, mission, responsibilities, scope, non-responsibilities, inputs, outputs, required evidence, allowed tools, forbidden actions, required skills, escalation rules, approval requirements, handoff contract, completion criteria) is present and non-empty.
